_about: What opens when (js/core/unlocks.js; decision 22). rules[id]: {"open": "always"}; {"after": {"arc": id}} (open once that arc is finished); {"after": {"arc": id, "chapter": n}} (once chapter n of it is finished); {"all": [...]}, {"any": [...]}. An id is a map place (data/map.json `unlock`) or a mode or errand. An id with no rule is closed and Unlocks.why() says it's unknown. The arc a rule waits for is what the locked place says ("locked until the beach story"). State per child lives in the save (story.arcs, unlocks.open). renamed: {old id: new id} when an id changes, so saves keep what they opened.
